radiology_report:
Subject: Multiparametric MRI Prostate | Facility: Amsterdam UMC, AMC | Date: 15 Feb 2025

Clinical indication: Elevated PSA at 9.8 ng/mL, obtained for routine surveillance imaging.

FINDINGS:
The gland exhibits marked hypertrophy, spanning roughly 5.8 × 5.2 × 4.6 cm and culminating in a total volume of 134.0 mL. Transition zone changes feature extensive benign nodular hyperplasia; the enlarged median lobe presses gently against the bladder base. Peripheral zone architecture remains uniform with standard T2 signal characteristics and absent restricted diffusion. Scanning reveals no focal abnormality warranting a PI-RADS 3 or greater classification. Contrast kinetics appear symmetric without suspicious enhancement. Seminal vesicles retain normal morphology. Capsular integrity is intact, and no suspicious lymph nodes are visualized.

IMPRESSION:
Prostatic hypertrophy (total volume 134.0 mL) lacking a PI-RADS 3+ focus.
PI-RADS 2.
PSA density: 0.073.
csPCa probability 0.5260261.
